# Casberi

> Casberi is a free iOS app that gathers everything you make — notes, links, screenshots, events, chats, voice notes, and the output of your apps and agents — into one private feed on your iPhone. One search finds everything. Your things live on your device, work offline, and leave only by your choice.

Key facts:

- Native iOS app (iPhone), free on the App Store.
- Everything becomes a "thing" in one feed; one search spans all of it.
- Capture in one gesture: share sheet, screenshots, Siri, paste, voice. Typed text never saves silently.
- Nearly a hundred apps connect as bridges: Photos, Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Apple Health, Apple Wallet, Strava, Apple Music, HomeKit, RSS, Substack, Bluesky, Farcaster, Reddit, Pinterest, Gmail, iCloud Mail, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Slack, Trello, Notion, Linear, Todoist, Stripe, PostHog, Sentry, Vercel, Cloudflare, App Store Connect, Readwise, Raindrop, Obsidian, Kindle, Cal.com, Calendly, YouTube, Podcasts, Twitch, Steam, Shopify, Deals, Open Food Facts, Instagram / Snapchat / TikTok / X imports, ChatGPT / Claude / Claude Code / Cursor / Gemini / Day One / Apple Journal imports, and more.
- Wallets and markets connect with no account and no key: watch a wallet by address or ENS/.sol name (or connect a wallet app), plus token watchlists, Coinbase, Kraken, Kalshi, OpenSea, GeckoTerminal, Stocktwits, Bitrefill, Peer, and 0xBow Privacy Pools. Every one of these is read-only — Casberi can never trade or move funds.
- One screen: your things in one feed, with a dock along the bottom — All, then a chip for each category, whose folder opens the apps inside it. No tabs, no home screen, no board. Your avatar opens Settings; the catalog of apps sits at the end of the strip.
- Each app opens as a room shaped like what's in it: Calendar reads as an agenda, Photos as a grid, a wallet leads with its balance. Home Screen widgets carry today's line, what's due, and your wallet; Spotlight and Shortcuts find any thing by what it says.
- Agents connect too: their output arrives in the feed with provenance, and any write waits for your tap (approvals). Casberi is also an MCP server — clients like Claude can search your things and propose saves you approve.
- Agent seats — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Venice, Bankr, or OpenRouter — connect with your own key, kept in the Keychain; requests go from the phone straight to that provider, never through a Casberi server.
- No account, no analytics, no trackers. iCloud sync is opt-in and off by default. Export, import, and delete-everything are real controls.
